denied.title: Restricted access
denied.hint: Checkout is reserved for salon accounts. Ask your administrator for access.

day.timeZoneHint: Times are shown in the salon’s time zone.

notInDay.title: Appointment not found on this day
notInDay.body: The requested appointment is not on the schedule for {date}. Change day, or pick one from the list below.

list.caption: Appointments of the day
list.emptyBody: Nothing to settle on {date}. Change day to find a service that was delivered.

recap.caption: Service to settle
recap.fixedPrice: Amount fixed at booking time. The total that counts is the one the server recalculates on validation — the front end never does that arithmetic.

method.cashHint: Recorded with the operator and a timestamp; the till is the reference at reconciliation. No call to the payment provider.
method.cardHint: The client enters their card in fields served by Stripe. No number is entered, seen or kept by the salon.

blocker.cancelled: This appointment is cancelled: the slot has been released, there is no service left to settle.
blocker.alreadySettled: This appointment has already been settled: a second payment would create one accounting record too many.
blocker.cardOpenBlocksCash: A card payment is already open on this appointment. Finish it — a cash settlement would be refused while it runs.
blocker.cardFailedBlocksCash: A failed card payment intent is still attached to this appointment. Resume the card — a cash settlement would be refused until it is cleared.
blocker.cardNotPayable: Card payment does not accept an appointment that is already completed or was a no-show. Settle in cash, or with the counter terminal.

settlement.title: Settled {method} — {amount}
settlement.nothingLeft: There is nothing left to settle on this appointment.

pci.cash: No call to the payment provider on this path: the sale is recorded with its operator and its timestamp, and the till is the reference at reconciliation.
pci.card: Card fields are served by Stripe: no number is entered here, nor written down anywhere else.
pci.cardForm: Card fields are served by Stripe: no number is entered anywhere else, written down anywhere else, or passed through the salon or our servers.

card.cashStillPossible: Settling in cash is still possible.
card.loadFailedScript: Stripe’s payment module could not be loaded. Check this workstation’s connection.
card.loadFailedEntrypoint: Stripe.js loaded without exposing its entry point.
card.loadFailedUnknown: The payment module could not be loaded.
card.notCompleted: The payment did not go through (state “{status}”). Nothing was charged: try again, or settle in cash.

receipt.heading: Till receipt
receipt.loadFailed: The receipt could not be loaded. Check the connection and try again.
receipt.label: Receipt
receipt.provisionalDisclaimer: The final confirmation is recorded by the signed webhook, server side: this receipt proves the attempt, not the capture.
receipt.cashDisclaimer: Cash settlement recorded and timestamped. The till is the reference at reconciliation.
receipt.settledCardDisclaimer: Card settlement recorded in the database, on confirmation from the signed webhook. This receipt is final.

completion.card: Moving the appointment to “completed” is not served by the API yet: the status will follow the webhook confirmation, with nothing to redo here.
completion.cash: Moving the appointment to “completed” is not served by the API yet: the settlement is recorded, and the appointment status will follow with nothing to redo here.

failure.providerUnreachable: The payment provider did not answer. Nothing was charged: try again, or settle in cash.
failure.alreadySettled: This appointment has already been settled. Reload the screen before carrying on — a second payment would create one accounting record too many.
failure.notPayable: Card payment does not accept this appointment: it is cancelled, completed or a no-show. Settle in cash if the service was delivered.
failure.notSettleable: This appointment is cancelled: there is no service left to settle.
failure.tooManyRequests: Too many payments opened in a short time. Wait a few seconds before trying again.
failure.notFound: This appointment cannot be found in this salon.
failure.forbidden: Your account is not allowed to take payments. Ask the salon administrator for access.

sale.itemUnavailable: An item on the receipt is no longer on sale. Remove it and reload the catalog before carrying on.
sale.currencyMismatch: An item on the receipt is priced in a currency other than the salon’s. It cannot be sold here: remove it from the receipt.
sale.amountOutOfRange: The total exceeds what a single receipt can carry. Reduce the quantities, or split it into several receipts.
sale.historyWindowInvalid: The requested period is empty: the end must come after the start.
sale.validation: The receipt was refused: a line is incomplete or out of bounds. Check the quantities before trying again.
sale.notFound: A service or an item on the receipt cannot be found in this salon.
sale.forbidden: Your account is not allowed to run the till. Ask the salon administrator for access.
sale.unavailable: The till is temporarily unreachable. The receipt was not recorded: try again in a moment.

pdf.failed: The receipt could not be produced. Please try again.
